cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

anyOf.title: Buy
anyOf.description: Pay `qty * price` of the deposit unit, receive `qty` fraction tokens.

anyOf.title: Redeem
anyOf.description: Burn `qty` fraction tokens, take the pro-rata slice of the pool.

anyOf.title: Distribute
anyOf.description: Pay income into the offering. Raises every holder's claim pro rata.

anyOf.title: SetStatus
anyOf.description: Committee moves the lifecycle: Open -> Closed -> Redeeming.

anyOf.title: SetFees
anyOf.description: Committee changes the fee rates, within the hard caps.

anyOf.title: ClaimFee
anyOf.description: Committee pays accrued fees out to the treasury key hash.

anyOf.title: Settle
anyOf.description:
Move the pledges spent in this transaction into the State and mint each
 owner their fractions. Keeper or committee.

anyOf.title: CloseRaise
anyOf.description: Raise succeeded: `Raising` -> `Operating`. Committee.

anyOf.title: FailRaise
anyOf.description: Raise failed after the settle window: `Raising` -> `Refunding`. Anyone.

anyOf.title: CancelRaise
anyOf.description: Stop a raise early: `Raising` -> `Refunding`. Committee.

anyOf.title: RefundFraction
anyOf.description: Burn `qty` fractions for `qty * price` units. Any holder, `Refunding`.

anyOf.title: Release
anyOf.description: Pay `amount` to the SPV against reviewed evidence. Committee.

anyOf.title: CommitPeriod
anyOf.description: Record a distribution period's manifest root. Committee.

anyOf.title: SetFees
anyOf.description: Change the settlement fee while raising. Committee.

anyOf.title: ClaimFee
anyOf.description: Pay accrued fees to the treasury. Committee.

anyOf.title: Rotate
anyOf.description: Replace the committee. Current committee.

anyOf.title: BeginWindDown
anyOf.description: Pay final sale proceeds in: `Operating` -> `WindingDown`. Committee.

anyOf.title: Redeem
anyOf.description: Burn `qty` fractions for a pro-rata slice of the pool. Any holder.

stellaris/fv2/Book.title: Book
stellaris/fv2/Book.description:
The money counters. Invariant 4: the State holds exactly
 `escrowed - released + pool` deposit units.

fields.title: settled
fields.description: Fractions minted by `Settle`, cumulative.

fields.title: outstanding
fields.description: Fractions in circulation.

fields.title: escrowed
fields.description:
Units paid in by settled pledges, less fees claimed and refunds paid.
 Includes `fees` until they are claimed.

fields.title: released
fields.description: Units released to the SPV so far.

fields.title: fees
fields.description: Accrued platform fees, unclaimed (held inside `escrowed`).

fields.title: pool
fields.description: Units held for holders in `WindingDown`.

fields.title: net_proceeds
fields.description: `escrowed - fees` at `CloseRaise`; 0 before.

stellaris/fv2/OfferingV2.title: OfferingV2
stellaris/fv2/OfferingV2.description: The single State UTxO of an offering.

fields.title: fee_bps
fields.description: Fee on settled proceeds. Moves only by `SetFees`, only while `Raising`.

fields.title: period
fields.description: Last committed distribution period.

fields.title: manifest_root
fields.description: Merkle root of the last committed period's payout manifest.

fields.title: committee
fields.description: Offering committee, M-of-N. Moves only by `Rotate`.

fields.title: offering
fields.description: Which offering: its State's thread-token policy (= offering script hash).

fields.title: owner
fields.description: Refunds and fractions go only to this address. Key payment credential.

fields.title: qty
fields.description: Fractions pledged.

fields.title: created
fields.description: Lower validity bound of the pledge transaction (checked at mint).

stellaris/fv2/Status.title: Status
stellaris/fv2/Status.description: Lifecycle (SPEC-v2.md §2). A move is legal only along the spec's arrows.

stellaris/fv2/Terms.title: Terms
stellaris/fv2/Terms.description: Fixed at `Open`. Every spend must return these unchanged.

fields.title: total_fractions
fields.description: Hard cap in fractions.

fields.title: soft_cap
fields.description: Fractions that must be settled for the raise to succeed.

fields.title: price
fields.description: Deposit units per fraction.

fields.title: deadline
fields.description: Last moment (POSIX ms) a pledge can be made.

fields.title: settle_window
fields.description: Time after the deadline for settling outstanding pledges.

fields.title: retained
fields.description: Units that may never be released to the SPV (D-7 hold-back).

fields.title: docs_hash
fields.description: Hash of the offering documents investors accepted.

fields.title: spv_payout
fields.description: The only payment credential `Release` may pay.

fields.title: treasury
fields.description: The only key hash `ClaimFee` may pay.

fields.title: issuer
fields.description: Signs `Open` with the committee.

fields.title: keeper
fields.description: May run `Settle` without the committee.

fields.title: fraction_policy
fields.description: The fraction token's minting policy (`fraction_v2` by default).

fields.title: eligibility_policy
fields.description: If set, a pledge settles only when its owner holds this token.

fields.title: unit_policy
fields.description: The deposit unit. Must equal the script's own parameters.

stellaris/offering/OfferingDatum.title: OfferingDatum
stellaris/offering/OfferingDatum.description: The single state UTxO of an offering.

fields.title: total_fractions
fields.description: Fractions that may ever exist. Immutable.

fields.title: minted
fields.description: Fractions minted so far, cumulative. Never decreases.

fields.title: outstanding
fields.description: Fractions currently in circulation (minted minus burned).

fields.title: price
fields.description: Price of one fraction, in base units of the deposit denomination.

fields.title: pool
fields.description:
Units held for holders: buy proceeds plus distributed income, less
 what redemption has already paid out.

fields.title: fees
fields.description: Units owed to the treasury and not yet claimed.

fields.title: issuer
fields.description: Issuer key hash — the party that lists and funds the asset.

fields.title: treasury
fields.description: Treasury key hash — the only address `ClaimFee` may pay.

fields.title: operators
fields.description: Committee that can move status and fees.

fields.title: threshold
fields.description: M of N.

fields.title: mint_fee_bps
fields.description: Fee taken on a purchase, in basis points of the purchase cost.

fields.title: redeem_fee_bps
fields.description: Fee taken on a redemption, in basis points of the gross payout.

fields.title: fraction_policy
fields.description: Minting policy of the fraction token. Bound to this script.

anyOf.title: Open
anyOf.description: Fractions can be bought. No redemption.

anyOf.title: Closed
anyOf.description: No buying, no redemption — the asset is funded and running.

anyOf.title: Redeeming
anyOf.description:
The asset is being wound up or income is being paid out: holders may
 burn fractions for their pro-rata slice of the pool.
